episodes.synopsis: The Imperial Revue puts on a brand new play as new villains lurk in the shadows.
episodes.title: The Curtain Rises! The New Combat Revue

episodes.synopsis: As Klara settles into life at the revue, a dashing figure named "White Cape" makes a furor in Tokyo.
episodes.title: Identity Unknown! A Mysterious Foe Appears

episodes.synopsis: The Moscow Combat Revue is alive and well, and they want Klara back. But Sakura isn't ready to hand her over without a fight!
episodes.title: Tokyo Trembles! The New Moscow Combat Revue!

episodes.synopsis: Hatsuho runs back home after embarrassing herself in the last battle. Sakura follows her and helps her with the upcoming shrine festival.
episodes.title: Friendship in Full Bloom! Thousand Year Cherry Blossoms!

episodes.synopsis: Claris and Azami go undercover to find out Klara's secret. What is she hiding from the rest of the Revue?
episodes.title: The Goofball Detective Combo! Find Klara's Secret!

episodes.synopsis: Klara visits an orphanage on the outskirts of town, where the sinister Black Cape waits to strike.
episodes.title: Strange and Bizarre! The True Identity of Black Cape!

episodes.synopsis: Seijuro takes Sakura on an outing to thank for her work as acting captain. But the rest of the Revue won't take their "date" lying down!
episodes.title: Stealth Mission! Tail the Date!

episodes.synopsis: The Moscow Combat Revue challenges the Flower Division for the rights to Klara in a combat competition! There's dancing, bread-eating, and more!
episodes.title: No End to the Chaos! The Combat Revue Challenge!

episodes.synopsis: The Flower Division seeks out Klara as the truth about the Moscow Combat Revue's ambitions is revealed.
episodes.title: Unbelievable! The Truth About Klara!

episodes.synopsis: Kaminski lays out his diabolic plan as he demands the world's nations surrender. Can they save Klara in time?
episodes.title: The Destruction of Tokyo? The Rage of Tunguska!
A Fantastic, Tragic Love! Leyla's Heart!

episodes.synopsis: The Combat Revues rally together to stop Kaminski from destroying Tokyo.
episodes.title: The Grand Finale! Hope for Tomorrow!
